changes.to: Maker datasheet (DARWIN-01, distributed also by its Japanese partner): 680 x 640 x 1,736 mm standing (1,142 mm squatting, 859 mm folded), 200 kg body weight, 10 kg rated payload with a dexterous hand (5 kg with an industrial gripper), 23+ DOF including end effectors (chassis 3, waist 4, 7 per arm, head 2), 0-1,900 mm working range, 1.5 m/s maximum speed with omnidirectional drive, +/-10 mm and +/-1-degree docking accuracy, 48 V 30 Ah battery (=1,440 Wh, derived; the maker states only 48 V 30 Ah) for 6 h and 0.5 h charge to 80% DOD, 0-50 C, dual diagonal 2D LiDAR with optional 3D LiDAR plus depth camera and 360-degree aerial and floor obstacle avoidance, Wi-Fi and 5G, VR teleoperation for data collection. Launched 2025 and shown at WAIC 2025 with Mech-Mind picking software. Standard Robots' own product page lists only the OASIS mobile platforms, so the datasheet PDF is the maker spec source.
VR remote operation, 5G teleoperation, secondary development

Standard Robots' DARWIN-01 industrial embodied robot: an omnidirectional wheeled base with a folding dual-arm upper body, built for shelf picking, machine tending and bin handling in warehouses and factories.
